comment: Per-version column header patterns for secondary sale registers. Each entry lists the header tokens (normalised: uppercase, non-alphanumeric stripped) to search for when mapping columns. Multiple tokens per field are tried in order; the first match wins. Version 'v1' is the baseline format observed for FY2021-22 through FY2025-26. If a later FY introduces new column names, add a new version key and reference it in secondary_sheets.json.

v1.comment: Baseline secondary register column layout. Header auto-detected by scanning first 20 rows for a row containing at least one header_anchor_token. grain_default describes the expected row-level data grain for this version; FY entries in secondary_sheets.json may override via a 'grain' field.
head: STATEHEAD

SALESHEAD
v1.comment_sub_total_skip: Normalised (uppercase, non-alphanumeric stripped) tokens that, when found in any of the first five cells of a row, mark the row as a sub-total/summary row to be excluded from data parsing. Only the first five cells are scanned to avoid false positives on amount columns. Applied to all FYs; particularly important for FY2023-24 which stores data at sub-total grain.
v1.comment_header_detection: Header row must contain at least one of header_anchor_tokens after normalisation. Scan the first 20 rows.
